[EN] "I understand."

[EN] "I'll keep an eye out."
[ES] "Estaré atento."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Amallen at Camp Retribution and ask what he needs.
[ES] Ve con Amallen en Camp Retribution y pregúntale qué necesita.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ordnarath
[ES] Ordnarath
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You see farming tool crates scattered around.
[ES] Ves cajas de herramientas de granja esparcidas por los alrededores.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Ordnarath and retrieve the document.
[ES] Ve a Ordnarath y recupera el documento.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Seach the crates for the document.
[ES] Registra las cajas en busca del documento.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ordnarath Report
[ES] Informe de Ordnarath
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Bedoram at Camp Redemption and deliver the document.
[ES] Encuentra a Bedoram en Camp Redemption y entrégale el documento.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll do whatever I can."
[ES] "Haré todo lo que pueda."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Teleport to the wagon through {@linkcreature:215#1027$$Bedoram} and protect it.
[ES] Teletranspórtate a la carreta a través de {@linkcreature:215#1027$$Bedoram} y protégela.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Protect the wagon. [Approach the wagon and select "Protect the Supply Carriage" to advance this quest.]
[ES] Protege la carreta. [Acércate a la carreta y selecciona "Proteger el carro de suministros" para avanzar en esta misión.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I can help."
[ES] "Puedo ayudar."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use {@LinkCreature:439#1004#Exit Teleportal} to return to Camp Redemption and speak with Bedoram.
[ES] Usa el {@LinkCreature:439#1004#Exit Teleportal} para regresar a Camp Redemption y hablar con Bedoram.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take blood samples from the local blood fiends.
[ES] Toma muestras de sangre de los demonios de sangre locales.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Rush the blood samples to Bedoram at Camp Redemption.
[ES] Lleva las muestras de sangre a toda prisa a Bedoram en Camp Redemption.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Glad to help."
[ES] "Un placer ayudar."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Right. Okay."
[ES] "Bien. De acuerdo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Happy to do my part."
[ES] "Encantado de aportar mi granito de arena."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "How did the analysis go?"
[ES] "¿Cómo fue el análisis?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
